messages:
mara: Quick sync — we need final web copy lanes for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before go-live. Who can own hero variants?
sam: I can take hosted hero + social launch post. Draft by EOD?
mara: thanks. Aim for short, tech-forward: emphasize predictable latency, cost controls, and switchable deployment modes. No jargon.
devin: For Dedicated, lean into reserved capacity & SLA. Suggested line: "Predictable throughput, reserved GPU pools — for mission-critical apps". thoughts?
leo: suggestion: tighten to "Predictable throughput & SLAs for mission-critical inference". shorter.
tara: Private page should highlight VPC & compliance. CTA options: "Request a private demo" vs "Contact sales for Private". prefer demo.
amy: webinar slot looks like Thurs 11am PT. Can we use it for benchmarks + customer panel?
ops-bot: :calendar: Webinar scheduled Thu 2023-11-09 11:00 PT (placeholder)
mara: yes — agenda: 1) Benchmark results (hosted vs self-hosted) 2) Migration playbook 3) Q&A with infra customer
sam: for launch posts — we'll need benchmark snippets in tweet + linked blog. Keep numbers digestible: e.g., "up to 3x throughput" or "~40% lower cost per token" with caveats.
devin: let's avoid overclaiming. Use ranges: "up to 2.5x" and cite test config in the blog. Add a modal on site linking to full benchmark.
leo: inbound routing: set up form that tags leads with mode interest (hosted/dedicated/private) + ARR band. Then map to SDR flows. tara: agree — also add checkbox for webinar attendees.
amy: design asks: need hero mock + CTA variants for A/B. can marketing drop final copy by tomorrow noon?
mara: I can deliver hosted + private hero lines by noon. Devin will finalize dedicated.
sam: I'll draft launch post copy and short benchmark bullets. Will ping for review.
devin: quick note on copy tone — keep engineering-first but not dense. e.g., replace "KV cache" with "response caching" where possible.
leo: also add microcopy under pricing pointing to Dedicated commit options and Private enterprise licensing.
ops-bot: :thumbsup: Checklist created: /launch-copy -> hosted, dedicated, private; /webinar -> agenda + speakers; /leadflow -> form fields
mara: sweet. follow-ups: @sam please post draft, @devin finalize dedicated hero, @amy upload variants. I'll collate and send to design.
sam: on it. ping me if you want stronger lead-gen hooks. :rocket:
